BTS Face Masks – 5-Pack Party Set - Jimi.README - how to print and cut.txt:
HOW TO PRINT AND CUT - BTS Face Masks – 5-Pack Party Set

1. Download each mask's print + cut PDF (links in 'README - masks in this pack.txt').
2. Print each on 350gsm silk card, SRA4 (225 x 320 mm), full colour, actual size (no scaling).
   Each face fills a 210 x 297 mm (A4) area centred on the sheet. One sheet per mask.
3. Ready to Wear / Ready Cut: load each sheet in the Intec ColorCut. The CUT layer is a magenta (CMYK 0,100,0,0)
   0.1 mm line, 2 mm inside the face edge, plus two almond eye holes (26 x 11 mm). Map Magenta = Cut in ColorCut Pro
   (or run 'Foxy - 1 Prepare cut file'). Hide/skip the CUT layer when printing.
4. DIY: print only, no cutting.
5. Pack all the masks together, flat, in one board-backed envelope, with elastic and sticky tabs for each mask
   supplied loose for the customer to attach.

No fonts are used in this artwork (photo faces only).
Made 6 Oct 2026 (foxyprinting-rebrand/tools/mask_packs_build.py, tools/artwork/mask_cutline.py).
